mentions.name: Aqueous
mentions.description: A next-generation compressed archive format. It supports streamed processing so very large inputs (e.g. disk images) can be handled without keeping intermediate results in memory or a spill file, and includes sparse file handling plus in-place move and delete operations on archive members.
